card.name: Ability verbs inside explanatory clauses
card.fires_on: Verbs of ability or continuation such as can, able, possible, remained, continues, right after a subject in a 'because' or 'unless' clause that gives a reason or condition.

modes.label: Ability after because
modes.description: The word can or able inside a clause giving a reason, saying what someone is able to do.
modes.example: The two types of birds belong to the same species, though, because they<< can>> produce fertile offspring

modes.label: Continuing or remaining state
modes.description: A verb of continuing or remaining in a clause explaining a cause or condition.
modes.example: the platelet count has<< remained>> at least 40 x 1

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about benefit or capability, though the promoted tokens are mixed and not very clear.
card.plain: It marks the verb in a reason clause that says someone can or is able to do something, or that something continues.
